note: Self-registration Kananaskis campground among the trees above the Sheep River in Sheep River Provincial Park, 35 km west of Turner Valley on Hwy 546, run by Kananaskis Campground Services. The hand-pump water is not safe to drink; bring water. Firewood is sold at the manager's site and from a firewood truck. Bluerock Equestrian is a separate horse campground to the west. --Claude
